manifest.name: dsh-clipboard-tools
manifest.description: System clipboard tools for DeepSeek Harness: read text or screenshots the user just copied, and put generated text or images on the clipboard so they can paste them anywhere.
manifest.author: kohjuz

bundle.text:
# dsh-clipboard-tools bundle patch.
#
# Mounts the plugin into a dsh profile composition. Every field under `config`
# is optional; the values below are the built-in defaults, kept here so they are
# discoverable in `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config`.
#
# Install: dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-clipboard-tools
- insert:
    - id: clipboard
      name: dsh-clipboard-tools
      config:
        # Maximum characters returned by clipboard_read (default 20000).
        maxChars: 20000
        # Where a read image is written, relative to the agent workspace.
        imageDir: clipboard
        # Per-call timeout for the platform clipboard helper, in milliseconds.
        timeoutMs: 8000

readme.text:
把系统剪贴板接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：AI 读得到你刚复制的文字和截图，也写得进剪贴板让你随手粘贴。

用 Agent 干活，最常断的是"最后一公里"：模型写好一段文案、一段 SQL、一张图表，你还得手动选中再复制；反过来你把报错贴进了聊天框，却还得先存成文件模型才读得到。这个插件把剪贴板本身做成两个模型工具。

> 名字说明：npm 上已经有一个只支持"写文本"的 `dsh-clipboard`，所以本包叫 **dsh-clipboard-tools**——它是超集：读 + 写、图片双向、Windows 下中文和 emoji 不丢字。

| 工具 | 作用 | 用户会怎么说 |
|---|---|---|
| `clipboard_read` | 读剪贴板里的文字；如果是图片，就存成 PNG 放进工作区，再交给 `read_image` 看 | "我刚复制的那段报错" / "看下我截的图" / "剪贴板里是什么" |
| `clipboard_write` | 把文字、文本文件内容或图片放进剪贴板 | "把这段放我剪贴板" / "这张图复制好，我去发群" |

仓库刚建好、还没发 npm 时，用 tarball 安装（推荐，依赖解析最干净）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kohjuz/dsh-clipboard-tools.git
cd dsh-clipboard-tools
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-clipboard-tools-0.1.0.tgz

发布到 npm 之后就是一条命令：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-clipboard-tools
```

`dsh plugin add` 会把 bundle 追加进该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，下次启动生效。验证装配：

```sh
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B2 -A6 dsh-clipboard-tools
```

| 平台 | 文本 | 图片 | 依赖 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | ✅ `Get-Clipboard` / `Set-Clipboard` | ✅ GDI+ | 系统自带 PowerShell |
| macOS | ✅ `pbpaste` / `pbcopy` | ✅（TIFF 经 `sips` 转 PNG） | 系统自带 |
| Linux / Wayland | ✅ `wl-paste` / `wl-copy` | ✅ | `apt install wl-clipboard` |
| Linux / X11 | ✅ `xclip` / `xsel` | ✅ 仅 xclip | `apt install xclip` |

先体检再排查：

```sh
node bin/clipboard.js doctor     # 打印识别到的后端和已安装的助手工具
node bin/clipboard.js selftest   # 真实写一次再读回来比对
```

在对话里说人话就行：

- "把我刚复制的那段日志读一下，找出报错行"
- "把 README 里「安装」那一节复制到我剪贴板"
- "把刚生成的图表复制好，我要发到群里"

模型侧等价于：

```json
{ "name": "clipboard_read",  "arguments": { "format": "auto" } }
{ "name": "clipboard_write", "arguments": { "path": "dist/report.md" } }
{ "name": "clipboard_write", "arguments": { "imagePath": "charts/revenue.png" } }
```

`clipboard_read` 也可以指定 `format: "text"` / `"image"` 跳过自动探测，或用 `saveDir` 指定图片落盘目录。

写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（或 `--patch` 覆盖层）：

```yaml
- id: clipboard
  config:
    maxChars: 20000      # 单次读取返回的最大字符数，超长截断并标记 truncated
    imageDir: clipboard  # 读到的图片落在工作区哪个目录

- **零运行时依赖**：不装任何 npm 包，平台能力全部走系统自带工具，安装不会污染 profile。
- **子进程 stdio 走临时文件，不走管道**：DSH 的 Windows 沙箱禁止命名管道，`stdio: 'pipe'` 会让子进程直接 `EPERM`；文件在沙箱内外都能用，顺带也更省内存。
- **每次调用都有超时**：剪贴板助手卡住时杀进程返回 124，不会拖住整轮对话。
- **Windows 文本经 UTF-8 文件进出**：不经过 argv / stdout，中文、emoji、长文本都不受控制台代码页影响。
- **图片先落盘再交给模型**：不把二进制塞进上下文，模型用 `read_image` 自己决定看不看。
- **工具定义与宿主解耦**：`lib/tools.js` 不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`，单测里传个假的 `defineTool` 就能跑全部逻辑。

- 只读写本机剪贴板，不联网。
- 除图片外不落盘；图片写到当前 agent 工作区（默认 `clipboard/`，文件名带时间戳）。
- 读到的内容会作为工具结果进入会话记录，和粘贴进对话是同一级别的暴露面；密码管理器一类的敏感内容请自己把握。
- `clipboard_write` 只写不读回，不会把剪贴板内容悄悄送给模型——除非你让它再读一次。

```
index.js            插件入口：name / inject / apply，只有 20 行
lib/clipboard.js    平台适配、进程调用、PNG 尺寸解析（零依赖，可单测）
lib/tools.js        两个 defineTool 定义（不 import 宿主包，可单测）
test/               node:test 用例（39 个）

```sh
npm test              # 跑全部用例（39 个）
npm run test:inline   # 在 DSH 沙箱里跑测试时用（沙箱禁管道 stdio，测试器起子进程会 EPERM）
npm run doctor        # 看本机剪贴板后端
npm run selftest      # 真实写读一次

- **Windows 11 + dsh 0.2.1-rc.5**：中文 + emoji 文本写入/读出无差异；320×200 PNG 写入后读回，尺寸与内容一致。
- **真实 Agent 链路**：在隔离 profile 里用 headless 跑一轮，模型调用 `clipboard_write` → `clipboard_read`，随后用 PowerShell `Get-Clipboard` 独立复核，剪贴板内容与指令一致。

System clipboard tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): let the agent read the text or screenshot you just copied, and put its own results on the clipboard so you can paste them anywhere.

The last mile of agent work is usually a manual copy-paste. This plugin turns the clipboard itself into two model tools.

| Tool | What it does | What a user says |
|---|---|---|
| `clipboard_read` | Read clipboard text; when the clipboard holds an image, save it as a PNG in the workspace for `read_image` | "the error I just copied" / "look at my screenshot" |
| `clipboard_write` | Copy inline text, a text file's content, or an image file | "put that on my clipboard" / "copy this chart, I'll paste it in chat" |

From a tarball (recommended until the package is on npm; cleanest dependency resolution):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kohjuz/dsh-clipboard-tools.git
cd dsh-clipboard-tools
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-clipboard-tools-0.1.0.tgz

Once published:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-clipboard-tools
```

`dsh plugin add` appends the bundle to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. Verify the layer:

```sh
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B2 -A6 dsh-clipboard-tools
```

| Platform | Text | Image | Requires |
|---|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | ✅ `Get-Clipboard` / `Set-Clipboard` | ✅ GDI+ | bundled PowerShell |
| macOS | ✅ `pbpaste` / `pbcopy` | ✅ (TIFF via `sips`) | nothing |
| Linux / Wayland | ✅ `wl-paste` / `wl-copy` | ✅ | `apt install wl-clipboard` |
| Linux / X11 | ✅ `xclip` / `xsel` | ✅ xclip only | `apt install xclip` |

Check the box before troubleshooting:

```sh
node bin/clipboard.js doctor
node bin/clipboard.js selftest
```

```yaml
- id: clipboard
  config:
    maxChars: 20000      # cap for clipboard_read, longer text is truncated and flagged
    imageDir: clipboard  # where a read image is written, relative to the workspace

- **Zero runtime dependencies** — every backend is an OS-provided tool.
- **Child stdio goes through temp files, not pipes** — DSH's Windows sandbox forbids the named pipes Node uses for `stdio: 'pipe'` (children fail with `EPERM`); files work in and out of the sandbox.
- **Every external call is bounded** by a timeout that kills the helper.
- **Windows text travels through a UTF-8 file**, bypassing argv/stdout and console code pages, so CJK and emoji survive intact.
- **Images are written to disk first**; the model decides whether to look with `read_image`.
- **Tool definitions are harness-free** (`lib/tools.js` imports no `@deepseek-ai/*`), so the whole surface is unit-testable.
Local clipboard only, no network. Only images are written to disk (under the agent workspace). Clipboard content becomes tool output in the session log — treat it as public within the conversation.

- Windows 11 + dsh 0.2.1-rc.5: CJK/emoji text roundtrip, 320×200 PNG roundtrip.
- A real headless agent turn: `clipboard_write` → `clipboard_read`, cross-checked with PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`.
